name: conflictlens
description: AI-powered semantic conflict and security risk detection — flags issues before merge.

codeguard.autoScan.description: When true, ConflictLens will automatically scan for risks every time a file is saved (debounced, 2 s). Defaults to false to avoid notification noise.

conflictlens.apiEndpoint.description: URL of the local ConflictLens analysis server (Members 1 & 2). Example: http://localhost:3000/analyze. Leave empty to use built-in mock data for offline / UI development.

conflictlens.apiTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time (ms) to wait for the local analysis API or Gemini before treating the request as timed out. Default 8000ms matches the PRD's ~5–10 s performance target.

conflictlens.geminiApiKey.description: Your Gemini API key (gemini-2.5-flash). Used to generate plain-English explanations and recommendations for each detected risk. Leave empty to skip AI enrichment.

scripts.compile:webview: cd webview && cmd /c npm run build
scripts.compile: npm run compile:webview && npm run compile:ext
